# OpenMoji teapot

The teapot paths in `TeapotShape.tsx` are adapted from OpenMoji's **Teapot (1FAD6)** by the OpenMoji contributors.

- Original: https://github.com/hfg-gmuend/openmoji/blob/master/color/svg/1FAD6.svg
- Project: https://openmoji.org/
- Artwork license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0).
- License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Changes: theme-aware colours, a spout opening, and placement in the animated scene. The adapted artwork remains licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. The cup, liquid trajectory, and animation are separate application code.

The upstream license is included in `LICENSE.txt`. Attribution is also displayed on the `/418` page.
